_comment: packages/core and packages/ui are vendored into all three mobile repos with
no shared package. CLAUDE.md calls them duplicates that must be kept
identical; that is true of packages/ui (17/17 files byte-identical) but NOT
of packages/core.
Every core file listed here was diffed on 2026-08-08. None is an un-ported
change — each difference is deliberate app-specific structure:
env.dart            each app targets its OWN API (mandir :3106,
devotee :3107, sant :3108). Making these identical
would point two of the three apps at the wrong API and
404 every call. The file's own comment records that the
sant app once shipped with :3106 for exactly that
reason — copying between repos IS the historic bug.
rbac.dart           mandir-mobile carries migration-031 module
entitlements and per-route gating; devotee and sant
have no tenant modules to gate (84 lines vs 46).
models.dart         mandir-mobile's Session/Dashboard carry `modules` and
`tiles`, which only a tenant-scoped app has.
auth_flow.dart      selectTenant() returns `modules` on mandir only —
auth_repository     same reason; devotee and sant have no tenant
session_manager     selection carrying entitlements.
api_client.dart     devotee adds getText() for the print-ready HTML
receipts and 80G certificates only it fetches.
jainerp_core.dart   devotee additionally exports
devotee_auth_repository.dart, which only it has.
So this file is NOT a list of debt to pay down — it is the set of
differences that are supposed to exist. The check fails on any shared file
NOT listed here, which is what catches a real un-ported fix.
Before adding an entry: diff it and satisfy yourself the difference is
structural. If it is a fix made in one app and not the others, port the fix
instead of baselining it.
